# Functional Rust

Use pure functions, native Results, exhaustive enums, borrowed inputs, and iterator transformations. Apply this pack to Rust source and examples.

Read `bytefarm/engineering` through the installation index first. Repository commands, the supported compiler, and dependency approval come from the consumer's operating instructions.

| Task                        | Read                                |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Design behavior             | [Paradigm](paradigm.md)             |
| Name declarations           | [Naming](naming.md)                 |
| Organize crates and modules | [File structure](file-structure.md) |
| Declare operations          | [Functions](functions.md)           |
| Model valid states          | [Types](types.md)                   |
| Handle branches             | [Conditionals](conditionals.md)     |
| Propagate failures          | [Errors](errors.md)                 |
| Borrow and transform values | [Ownership](ownership.md)           |
| Compose iterators           | [Utilities](utilities.md)           |
| Document contracts          | [Comments](comments.md)             |
| Verify behavior             | [Testing](testing.md)               |
